mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.5% indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 indicates a supply shock that elevates inflation and compresses corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 315 indicates accelerating inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 315, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising nonfarm employment level (PAYEMS) above its 6-month moving average signals labor market strength that increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above its 3-month moving average indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105 signals robust supply growth that enhances corporate output and profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
